gloss: overall situation; big picture; general situation

definitions.gloss: overall situation; big picture; general state of affairs
definitions.explanation: The broad, strategic view of a situation, as opposed to individual details. Used when discussing matters from a high-level perspective.

examples.japanese: {大局|たいきょく}を{見|み}て{判断|はんだん}する。
examples.english: To judge by looking at the big picture.

examples.japanese: {大局|たいきょく}{的|てき}な{視点|してん}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
{細|こま}かいことにこだわらず、{大局|たいきょく}を{見失|みうしな}わないようにしなければならない。
examples.english: We must not get caught up in the details and lose sight of the big picture.

notes:
Composed of {大|たい} (big) and {局|きょく} (situation, phase). Used for strategic thinking where one steps back from details to consider the whole.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大局|たいきょく}を{見|み}る: to look at the big picture
- {大局|たいきょく}{的|てき}: big-picture, from an overall perspective
- {大局|たいきょく}を{見失|みうしな}う: to lose sight of the big picture
- {大局|たいきょく}{観|かん}: a broad perspective
- {大局|たいきょく}に{立|た}つ: to take a big-picture standpoint

USAGE:
Often used in business, politics, and strategic discussions. The derived form {大局|たいきょく}{的|てき} (big-picture, overall) is very common as an adjectival modifier.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {全体|ぜんたい}: the whole — more concrete, refers to all parts combined
- {大局|たいきょく}: big picture — strategic overview, more abstract
- {全貌|ぜんぼう}: full picture — complete view of something being investigated
- {概観|がいかん}: general survey — an overview or broad look

NOTE:
The homophone {対局|たいきょく} means a game (of go, shogi, etc.) — completely different meaning.
